ModMetaData.name: Props in Use
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Decorative props that already look like something useful, made to actually be that thing.
Prop mods are full of objects that stop at the picture. A guitar on a table is scenery; a fountain in a garden is scenery; a hedge grown from anima bark is scenery. This mod plugs a handful of them into the systems they were clearly drawn for, and changes nothing else about them: same texture, same cost, same place in the build menu.
WHAT IT DOES
- Miniature Props and Decor: the nine instruments on its prop shelf become playable instruments through Musical Instruments (Continued). A colonist walks up, sits down and plays. The metronome is left alone. - Miniature Props and Decor: the handheld game console and the ham radio become recreation sources — dexterity play and solitary relaxation. Both already sat in a file called Buildings_Recreation with no recreation type on them. - Alpha Props - Parks and Gardens: the seven ornamental fountains become natural meditation foci, scaled by size, and stop counting as artificial construction near other foci. - Alpha Props - Parks and Gardens: the anima and gauranlen hedges already carry a meditation focus strength that nothing in the game ever reads. They now feed that strength into nearby anima trees, animus stones and nature shrines, and likewise stop counting against them.
Every change is a guarded patch. If a source mod is absent, its patch does nothing and reports nothing. Nothing here contains another author's files.
No save data of its own. Adding it mid-save is safe; removing it leaves props that are once again only props.
